drafts.cue: When your family-agreed shared moment begins.
drafts.why: A concrete pause supports a family-agreed shared moment while keeping essential access available.
steps: Place your device in the agreed spot.
drafts.title: Pause and park entertainment
drafts.kid_hint: You can keep important device access available.
drafts.strategy: Model the family agreement and make exceptions clear without treating parking as punishment.
drafts.help_text: You can ask for help, watch, decline, or take a break; essential access stays available.
drafts.completion: You paused your video and parked your device.
drafts.description: Practice pausing entertainment and placing the device in the family-agreed spot for a shared moment.
drafts.instruction: Pause your video and park your device.
drafts.parent_setup: Agree on the moment and reachable parking spot; keep communication, medical, safety and learning access available.

parent_guidance.coach: Model parking your own device and help save or pause entertainment if needed.
parent_guidance.if_hard: Offer assistance, watching, declining, or a break without penalty; keep essential access available.
parent_guidance.observe: Notice whether the agreed pause worked for the moment and revise if it blocked a real need.
parent_guidance.prepare: Choose a reachable, safe spot and agree which entertainment use pauses for this moment.

drafts.cue: When the agreed pause for a shared family moment begins.
drafts.why: Saving first can make the agreed entertainment pause clearer and more manageable.
steps: Save your game if you can.
Place your device in the agreed spot.
drafts.title: Save and park a game
drafts.kid_hint: You can ask for help with saving or parking.
drafts.strategy: Keep the agreement specific to the moment, and help with the device when requested.
drafts.help_text: You can ask for help, watch, decline, or take a break; essential access stays available.
drafts.completion: You saved your game and parked your device.
drafts.description: Practice saving an entertainment game before placing the device in the agreed spot for a family-agreed moment.
drafts.instruction: Save your game, then park your device.
drafts.parent_setup: Confirm the game can be saved and the spot is accessible; preserve required learning and assistive functions.

parent_guidance.coach: Offer help with saving or placing the device while keeping needed functions available.
parent_guidance.if_hard: Suggest a smaller step, assistance, watching, declining, or a break without penalty.
parent_guidance.observe: Notice whether saving and parking fit the moment; adjust the agreement if needed.
parent_guidance.prepare: Check that the game has a save option and the device can be parked safely.

drafts.cue: When an agreed device pause could affect an essential use.
drafts.why: Speaking up helps the family agreement account for essential communication, medical, safety, or learning needs.
steps: Notice if parking would affect an essential use.
Tell your adult what needs to stay available.
drafts.title: Signal an access adjustment
drafts.kid_hint: Your essential communication and safety needs matter.
drafts.strategy: Respond calmly to access concerns and revise the agreement rather than pressuring device parking.
drafts.help_text: You can ask for help, use another way to communicate, watch, decline, or take a break.
drafts.completion: You told your adult what essential use needs to stay available.
drafts.description: Practice telling an adult when parking entertainment would affect an essential device use, so the family can adjust the agreement.
drafts.instruction: Tell your adult if parking affects an essential use.
drafts.parent_setup: Explain which uses must stay available and agree how an adjustment can be requested privately.

parent_guidance.coach: Listen without arguing and help keep required communication, medical, safety, or learning access available.
parent_guidance.if_hard: Accept another communication method, a smaller practice, watching, declining, or a break without penalty.
parent_guidance.observe: Notice access concerns and revise the family agreement so needed functions remain available.
parent_guidance.prepare: Make a private, accessible way to communicate an essential access concern.
